about.title: Compagnia Artistica Gaudeamus.
about.lead: Founded in Aberdeen in May 2023, Gaudeamus was created to give the Italian community in Scotland a place to meet, socialise and celebrate its culture through theatre. In a short time, the company has become a cultural reference point for Italians in Scotland — and for anyone who wants to discover Italian theatre and culture.
about.historyBody: In September 2023 Gaudeamus was officially recognised as a Scottish Charity (SC052772), making it the only theatre company in Scotland to stage productions entirely in Italian, accessible to a Scottish audience through live English subtitles. In January 2025 the company joined the Albo Consolare delle Associazioni Culturali Italiane nel Regno Unito, further consolidating its institutional role in promoting Italian art and culture.
about.missionBody: To preserve and pass on the Italian language and Italian culture — especially to new generations of Italo-Scots — offering them a direct link to their roots. We believe in theatre and art as tools for inclusion and cultural dialogue, capable of breaking down linguistic and social barriers and bringing the Italian and Scottish communities together through meaningful, engaging performances.
about.missionExtra1: Gaudeamus is not only theatre, but a vehicle for cultural and artistic outreach. Through our productions and activities we offer an immersive experience of Italian theatrical heritage — staging classical and contemporary authors and reinterpreting them for today, while exploring universal themes such as identity, integration and cultural memory.
about.missionExtra2: We promote bilingualism as a tool for personal growth and cultural connection. Through theatre workshops, educational activities and training sessions, Gaudeamus actively helps people of all ages and levels — children and adults, native speakers and beginners — encounter the Italian language as a living, performed thing. We believe bilingualism not only strengthens the bond with one's roots, but also opens new opportunities for dialogue, inclusion and intercultural understanding.
about.doingProductions: Theatre productions — staging works by Italian authors with an original, contemporary touch.
about.doingWorkshops: Theatre and language workshops — open to Italians and non-Italians, for exploring acting and the Italian language.
about.doingEvents: Cultural events — readings, talks, lectures and dinners that bring the community together.
about.doingCollaborations: Collaborations — festivals and theatre seasons across Scotland with the support of Italian and local institutions, plus joint projects with artists across the UK and Italy.
about.valueArtBody: The stage is our craft. Italian drama, performed live, is the centre of everything we do.
about.valueCommunityBody: We build a place where Italians in Scotland — and Scots curious about Italy — can meet, talk and share.
about.valueAccessBody: Italian on stage, English in subtitles. You don't need to speak Italian to belong here.
about.staffBody: Compagnia Artistica Gaudeamus is run by a small board of trustees and volunteers, with a wide community of artists, members and supporters across Scotland.
about.joinBody: We are a charity open to everyone: actors, theatre lovers, students of Italian culture and literature, volunteers and supporters. Theatre and art are home to us — and we want to share them with you.
about.partnersBody: Com.It.Es. Scotland & Northern Ireland · Italian Cultural Institute, Edinburgh · Italian Consulate General, Edinburgh · Italian Honorary Consulate, Aberdeen · London One Radio.

teatro.title: Theatre is the backbone of Gaudeamus.
teatro.lead: For our charity, theatre is much more than an art form — it is a powerful tool of social value. It nurtures dialogue, prompts reflection and strengthens our sense of community. Every production we make is performed in Italian, with live English subtitles.
teatro.leadInclusion: It is a space of expression and inclusion, where cultures meet and identities are built. Through storytelling, theatre raises awareness of social themes, fosters empathy and helps build a more cohesive community.
teatro.leadExtra: It is also, of course, a place of joy and shared time.

giftAid.title: Make your donation worth 25% more.
giftAid.lead: If you are a UK taxpayer, Gaudeamus can reclaim 25p from HMRC for every £1 you donate — at no cost to you. Fill in the declaration below and your donation will go further.
giftAid.explainerBody1: Gift Aid is an HMRC scheme for UK charities. We can only claim it if you sign a declaration confirming that you are a UK taxpayer and that you have paid (or will pay) at least as much Income Tax or Capital Gains Tax in the relevant year as we will reclaim on your donations.
giftAid.explainerBody2: If your circumstances change — you stop paying enough tax, change name or address — please let us know.
giftAid.consentLabel: I confirm I am a UK taxpayer and want Compagnia Artistica Gaudeamus SCIO to claim Gift Aid on this donation and on any donations I make in the future or have made in the last four years. I understand that if I pay less Income Tax and/or Capital Gains Tax than the amount of Gift Aid claimed on all my donations in that tax year, it is my responsibility to pay any difference.
giftAid.success: Thank you. Your declaration has been recorded. We will be in touch.
